comment: A still beam of pale light from a crack high in a wall, which falls into the room to its south (D-849, D-918). The decor file of a map places it on a wall, as it places a torch. The color is a palette key, and the strength is the light that the top of the beam adds, in basis points of that color. The beam slants east by the slant over its length, grows a little wider as it falls, and fades to nothing at its foot. A shimmer depth of 0 keeps the beam still (D-921). The shaft pass draws it above the fog, so it never glows (D-916, D-919).
